lines: Perumal Ramamurthy Srinivasan may sell up to ₹0.91 crore of shares in the offer for sale, if all offered shares are sold.
The shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, so this trigger is recent and the sale is worth discussing now.
Retained holding is an estimate of ₹2.13 crore at offer price, with average acquisition cost unknown.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in one section only.
